role: Evaluator-visible mapping from compiled Scenario JSON fields to Mesa model constructor inputs

schema_version.reason: The schema version selects the governed input contract and is not a model constructor parameter.

project_identity.source: Project JSON identity envelope and Scenario compiler provenance
project_identity.reason: Identity fields trace the compiled platform chain and do not change simulation dynamics.

mission_profile.source: project.missionProfile, project.basicMissions including missionPhases, legacy project.missionPhases fallback, and project.airports

equipment_tree.source: project.components[] hierarchy with failureDistribution, kOutOfN, productType, quantity, and specialRepairProfile

support_network.source: project.supportNodes[] for the unchanged runtime support-point projection; canonical project.supportOrganization, supportNodes[].organizationNodeId, supportResources[].organizationNodeId, and project.transportPolicies[] organization endpoints compile to support_network.organization_graph
support_network.runtime_deferred: support_network.organization_graph is validated and preserved for later behavior activation; it does not change current resource selection or metrics

support_activities.source: project.supportActivityJobs[] definitions plus project.supportActivities[] activityCodes/predecessors DAG

time.source: project.missionProfile.durationHours and M9.7 default tick/sample policy

monte_carlo.source: project.experiment.samples and formal ExperimentPlan.config.analysisRequests.largeSample sweep via MonteCarloRunConfig; persisted Project sweep arrays are stripped

stop_policy.source: ExperimentPlan.config.stopPolicy, defaulted to duration stop when absent
